note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written for this entry, in the author's own words, from the cited sources. 'confirmed: false' marks the two trophies no guide had pinned down by 2026-11-20.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops. Nothing here needs online play or DLC. The last trophies to fall are usually the 100% checklist and the long grinds — shooting-range golds, 250 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours; Push Square puts it at 250+ hours.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — it pops the moment the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Chapter 1 ends as the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins — the trophy pops there.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Chapter 2 ends when the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, starts.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Chapter 3 ends after the first two missions of Chapter 4 — Ocean Beach and Another Life. GTABase confirms the same timing.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Chapter 4 ends with its final mission, Starting From Zero — the trophy pops when that mission ends.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy and the only gold in the story. Finish the final mission of the campaign and it pops with the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only opens after the story. PowerPyx stresses it is closer to 60% true completion: scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, finish any 100 optional missions and 70 of 80 challenges, complete 300 stunts and 15 of 18 meditations. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing toward 100% is missable.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the categories and pick what is quickest — PowerPyx calls the under-the-bridge flights the fastest. Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (score a hoop), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count in Progress > Activities. Most of these happen naturally while you work on the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. This is the hardest skill trophy after 100% — take it slow, one range at a time. A bonus: gold medals here also unlock the ammo cheats (Max Ammo, Infinite Ammo, No Reload), per AlcastHQ.

sources.name: AlcastHQ — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races exist in total, but you only need one win per location). PowerPyx has a guide to all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the easiest ones and skip the rest. A race win also counts toward one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game (called Video Games in-game). There are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, all playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, plus Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. You must finish all of a game's levels once; the extra challenges are not required. Pick whichever you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3, while playing as Lucia, Andy calls and then texts you her home address in Belville, which marks the questline. Complete all 5 Andy quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass. All of them are still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline, marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the mission Island Dreams (work for Kenton) he calls, then shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map: dive down, use the metal detector to dig the treasure off the ocean floor and bring it back. He wants 7 shipwrecks cleared in total, in sets — turn in one set and he calls you back with more. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He goes quiet in Chapters 2-3 and returns later; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all 5 Billy quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. All of them are still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands — but only certain questlines count. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. Confirmed counting so far: Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, and PowerPyx notes more strangers are still being found. Check the trophy tracker in the trophy list to see your count. All strands are still available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, which also unlocks the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. Randy hands you a wishlist of 16 sports cars to deliver to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Scan a car with the WAiNK app to see if it is on the list, then drive it back — a car delivered in good condition pays more. He marks cars for you automatically, and marks new locations as you deliver; they turn up often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. Still doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City — go and destroy them (quest: Take Out Kitty Litter). Once you have destroyed enough labs, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, which unlocks the trophy. All of it is still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Chapter 1 only: the first meditation happens at Jason's house, on the balcony, the morning after the mission Down to Earth. Do it before Chapter 1 ends — it never comes back.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as +2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. It becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts Jason (Lucia cannot receive the message) and marks the quest Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Do his hunting quests — in the first one he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 — and hunt the unique animal he requests. Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck: there are 15 Target Decks, and all 15 are needed for 100%. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets hidden across Leonida, and PowerPyx has a location guide for all of them — follow it set by set instead of wandering.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: hold Up then R1 to scan objects in the world. There are more than 100 — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus tags — so scan any 100 you pass. PowerPyx has a guide to each category.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges (the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops along the way). Track them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies — save this for late, then pick the easiest ones you have left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Earliest after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner with hold Right + Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level together, then escape the red heat zone: the trophy pops when you drive out of it, not when you leave the flashing search area. Easiest route: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults in Chapter 4, which always trigger 4-star wanted levels.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can play with your partner. Call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), then rob 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while keeping the flashing red/blue wanted level the whole time — do not let it drop, and do not let it rise to the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline). A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City (available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): loot a couple of items in each and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The unlock is delayed — it pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop, so hit a 4th shop if it does not appear.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly): look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. You only need to scan them — driving them is not required. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. There are 557 vehicles at launch; the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so keep scanning past 100. Check your totals in Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm). It slows time and highlights weak spots, but only lasts a few seconds: buff your focus first with food, drinks or a face wash/shower at home, and use Adrenaline to stretch it. Wear body armor, use an assault rifle like the Duke 556, and line up 5 enemies at a gang operation. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by Focus Level 4 it gets much easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — the planes parked out on the airfield do not work. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, use the stairs next to the boarding bridge to walk straight into the plane, get in the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off. Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops — the unlock is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base: drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance. Get in a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies (green map icons). Break in through a back door with the Snap Gun: when you approach a locked door you get the choice to kick it (sets off the alarm) or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Inside, find the note with the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe) — it is the introduction to bank vault robberies and you do the first one as part of it: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag (hold Right to hand one off). After that, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 each (finish his earlier Payday Loans quests first). Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults — the 100% checklist needs all 8, so keep going. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to go unrecognized. One vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… counts automatically — tailing the truck to a bank and robbing its vault qualifies. Earlier method: spot an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests). Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area that is still black fog on the map until all of it is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops along the way. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: RESOLVED after release (checked 2026-11-20): go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar and the trophy pops. PowerPyx confirmed the exact bar and the exact drink on 19 November 2026, with screenshots; GTABase agrees the trigger is a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. The unlock is slightly delayed and pops after you drive further down the street. Only this blue Banshee works, not any other car.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation, marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first; you need them for the safe. Inside, pick up: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the contents of the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it open with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss an item, the operation respawns later, so it is not missable — you do not need all 3 in one visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time — check it in Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, then scroll to Strength (heart icon). Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a gym membership and always train together: call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), and while one character works out, the other trains too, so you progress twice as fast. Find fitness clubs under Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications) to see each one land. Finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence and clean escapes push you Professional; incapacitating enemies without killing them is Hardened; killing is Violent; killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones, is Psycho. It comes passively with the other trophies. If it is the last one left, farm it by running over civilians and cops — but do not push to Irredeemable, which is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: STILL UNCONFIRMED — checked 2026-11-20, two days after release, and no guide has pinned down the trigger yet. The description says only 'Second time's the charm.' PowerPyx's current best guess is that it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue; GTABase also lists the exact steps as unconfirmed. Do not chase a specific method until a guide confirms one — it may well pop during normal play.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light in the sky. Approach the UFO and it drops the woman it abducted — talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed: if the car is not there, drive away and come back.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: STILL UNCONFIRMED — checked 2026-11-20, two days after release, and no guide has pinned down the trigger yet. The description says only 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.' PowerPyx's current best guess is that it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle; GTABase also lists the exact steps as unconfirmed. The bowling name is a pun on the drive-by, not on the bowling alley — do not waste time on the lanes until a guide confirms the method.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 total is cumulative, not in one trip. Bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 per robbery, so this comes naturally with the other robberies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there, since they are the most expensive things you can buy. It counts across every shop type, so it builds up while you gear up for the other trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties ($160,000 in total). They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4. The garages also add the parking spots you need for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). The app lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. You need enough garage spots first (see Little Boxes), and cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the registration cost down.
